from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
a=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png')).astype(int)
H,W,_=a.shape
# classify pixels into broad color bins and print downsampled grid
r,g,b=a[:,:,0],a[:,:,1],a[:,:,2]
def label(i,j):
    R,G,B=r[i,j],g[i,j],b[i,j]
    mx=max(R,G,B);mn=min(R,G,B)
    if mx<45: return '#'      # near black (black metal rack, gripper)
    if mx>215 and (mx-mn)<35: return 'W' # white/light
    if R>120 and G>80 and B<90 and R>B+40: return 'w' # wood brown
    if R>180 and G>170 and B>150: return 'o' # offwhite plate
    if abs(R-G)<25 and abs(G-B)<25: return '.' # gray
    if R>=G and G>=B: return 'y' # warm
    if B>R+20: return 'b'
    return '?'
# downsample 4x4 blocks majority
for i in range(0,H,4):
    row=''
    for j in range(0,W,4):
        from collections import Counter
        c=Counter()
        for di in range(4):
            for dj in range(4):
                c[label(i+di,j+dj)]+=1
        row+=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    print(row)
\""
